_comment: SCCL v5 — 2x2 FACTORIAL: in-update base anchor (v4) x family-stratified RRV veto (v5). Gold-free throughout: anchor target = model's own LoRA init; veto re-executes stored SELF-tests only. Same stream/hash as v2/v3/v4 (554ce43f182b). BREAKTHROUGH target: sccl_anchor_strat approaches frozen arith (~0.60) while keeping anchor-like ACC.
